about: TFN OS: the extra ABI names. These are firmware or ESP-IDF names that no built-in app calls, but that app packages can call. sdk/tools/abi_gen.py adds them to main/tfn_abi.json for each board kind, and the next firmware links them. A developer asks for a name with the file that mk_app.py writes (sdk/out/<id>/abi_request.json): see sdk/docs/raw.md. perms: the permission classes (the bit stays the same inside one ABI version; text = the line that the STORE shows before an install). names: name, perm (optional: a name with no perm is free for each app), why, by.
